intelligence.human_view: Think of a royal household on a busy morning: the king wakes, and his whole day is laid out before him — his name, a wise word, every appointment, unfolding one beautiful section at a time, inside a chamber whose edges are as finely made as its center. That is the day view. Around it, the household keeps its disciplines: the captain reads every page herself before it reaches him, because a fix that passes its own check can still leave the page a mess; the work shows itself early, version by version, so drift is caught in minutes instead of rounds; the good pictures on the wall are the standard every build is measured against; and nothing is mixed — all the good together, never good standing next to terrible. The color of the day is the day's own: Wednesday blue, Sunday purple, each day its color from the same family. The door to a meeting sits on the meeting itself. And when a journey ends, it lands where it began — at the name, then home.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine your day opens like a royal report, just for you. It says your name, gives you a wise little saying, and shows your whole day, one lovely part at a time. Wednesday is blue, like the sky. Purple is Sunday's color. The little jewel on the page changes color every day, and the color is the day — no words needed. The door to join your meeting sits right on the meeting, so one tap takes you in. And before anyone shows you a page, the captain reads the whole page herself, top to bottom, to make sure it is beautiful and right.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, when he wakes up, dear, his day should open like a beautiful present, dear — his name, a wise little saying, his whole day unfolding, dear, one lovely part after another, dear. The captain reads the whole page herself first, dear, phone first, top to bottom, dear, before anything goes to him, dear — because a little fix can pass its check, dear, while the whole page is still a mess, dear. Wednesday is blue, dear, like a lovely sky blue, dear — and purple is Sunday's colour, dear, not Wednesday's. The little jewel changes colour with the day, dear, and the colour IS the day, dear, so it needs no words at all, dear. And when a story ends, dear, we take him home — to write his name, and then into the Hub, dear.
intelligence.naya_view: THE CAPTAIN LOOKS FIRST — NO LINK GOES TO HIM ON A SEAT'S PASS ALONE. WORK BACK-TO-BACK — SHOW VERSION ONE WHILE IT IS LIVE. THE DAY VIEW IS THE KING'S DAILY REPORT. THE COLOR IS THE FREQUENCY — NO TEXT ON IT. WEDNESDAY IS KANYE BLUE. JOIN GOES WHERE THE MEETING LIVES. HOLD WHAT HE LOVES; LAND WHERE IT BEGAN.
